name: [🌱] Grass Incremental Simulator
desc:
A relaxing lawn-trimming simulator game 🌿
The more you rebirth and upgrade, the more fun the game becomes!

[🔪] Trim the grass!
[🚀] Upgrade for faster trimming!
[🔥] Unlock new islands and upgrades!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a Like and Favorite!
❤️ Join the Unequal Games group for in-game boosts!

🛠️ Early access: Features may change, and bugs may appear.
